response.original_title: Mein Mann, mein Mörder – Wegsehen tötet
response.overview: This Sky Original documentary reconstructs an extraordinary true-crime case, focusing not on the perpetrator, but on the women—and their desperate attempts to break free from his violence. For the first time, Winfried’s first wife, Marja-Leena, and his daughter, Tuija, speak publicly about their experiences.
response.title: Mein Mann, mein Mörder – Wegsehen tötet
